verdict.rationale: Jev returns typed structured answers rather than streamed tokens, and a hands-on community report shows sub-second full answers (under 400ms via OpenRouter). The vendor docs only give relative speed claims for batching (10.0x faster), not documented absolute latency behavior. missing for 10: first-party documented latency figures or SLAs, any streaming mode, independent corroboration beyond a single anecdote.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream responses token by token (or get sub-second full answers) with the latency behavior documented

citations.quote: I gave JEV a shot via OpenRouter and it has a reply in less than 400ms, it's fast enough and cheap enough that you can hook it up to a game loop
batching every question into one TypeSafe call is 12.2x cheaper and 10.0x faster with no change in answers
